description: CAMBER Road Traffic Accident Dataset – Municipality of Trikala, Greece (2024–2025) is a data set deposited in Zenodo by its authors Ioannis Panagiotopoulos. This dataset contains georeferenced road traffic accident records for the Municipality of Trikala (Δήμος Τρικκαίων), Greece, covering the period from January 2024 to January 2025. The dataset is provided in Microsoft Excel format and contains 15 individual accident records. Coverage: national (GR); the metadata date the deposit to 2026. The formats are not stated in the metadata. It is reached through its DOI or landing page, listed on this page. Access is free of charge and open according to the repository. The licence is CC-BY-4.0. Caveats: written from the DataCite metadata (title, abstract, subjects and rights) read on 2026-09-29; the deposit itself was not opened or downloaded, so its contents, quality and current availability were not checked. It can support transport-network, traffic and mobility studies. Related record: the repository-level record data-zenodo-repository.
